Development binaries for OpenBeken firmware 13.0.0.2 on ESP32

Firmware for ESP32 with easy configuration using webUI, OTA updates, automation using timers or rules, expandability and
entirely local control over MQTT, HTTP, Serial or KNX.

See CHANGELOG for latest changes.

Find release binaries for OpenBeken firmware at http://ota.OpenBeken.com/OpenBeken32/release/.
Find release binaries for OpenBeken firmware on ESP8266 at http://ota.OpenBeken.com/OpenBeken/release/.

For an initial installation of OpenBeken use the webinstaller.

If you benefit from the OpenBeken project please consider making a donation.



These binaries are built using core 2.0.10
